title: Transcript of conversation with Ms. A.

sections.heading: Usage
sections.text: - This is one of the major evidence used in The Ticket

sections.heading: Location
sections.text:
In the bedroom safe of apartment 2 on the second floor of the Cardinal apartment complex at Streets of Tarkov. A Cardinal apartment key is required to access it.

To open the safe, a TerraGroup Labs keycard (Black) has to be swiped at the keycard panel behind the painting. Opening the safe consumes no uses.
